testResults.name: focused-ruff-lint
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ruff check src/lake/session_ranges.py tests/test_session_ranges.py

testResults.name: focused-ruff-format
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ruff format --check src/lake/session_ranges.py tests/test_session_ranges.py

testResults.name: focused-ty-type-check
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ty check src/lake/session_ranges.py tests/test_session_ranges.py

testResults.name: focused-calendar-tests
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_session_ranges.py
